go.resolution: Resolve the import path within the current module, parse its non-test Go files, and require exactly one matching declaration.

typescript.resolution: Use the TypeScript compiler API to require exactly one named top-level function, class, interface, type, enum, or variable declaration. Export is preferred but not required for same-module ownership.

forbidden: bare file paths without a declaration
symbols outside the repository or current module graph

direct_callee_scope.go: Named, statically resolved direct callees in the same Go package.
direct_callee_scope.typescript: Named, statically resolved direct callees in the web npm workspace; imported third-party, dynamic, anonymous, and transitive calls are excluded.
direct_callee_scope.budget: The reviewer records the root plus at most eight direct callees; unresolved or over-budget behavior is not-determinable.
direct_callee_scope.purpose: A bounded source slice prevents both a misleading single-function view and an unreviewable transitive call graph.
